executivo.nota: Leis: as 205 leis ordinárias e complementares com data a partir de 1º/1/2025 cadastradas no SAPL da Câmara, venham de quem vierem (a prefeitura sanciona quase todas). As leis que a própria Câmara promulgou (tipo “Lei Promulgada” no SAPL) ficam fora. Faltam no SAPL 3 dos 173 números de lei do período. Vetos: os projetos que, pelo andamento registrado no SAPL, receberam veto total ou parcial a partir de 1º/1/2025.
executivo.nota_en: Laws: the 205 ordinary and complementary laws dated from January 1, 2025 on in the City Council's SAPL system, whoever proposed them (the mayor's office signs almost all of them). Laws promulgated by the Council itself (type “Lei Promulgada” in SAPL) are left out. 3 of the 173 law numbers in the period are missing from SAPL. Vetoes: the bills that, according to the progress recorded in SAPL, were vetoed in whole or in part from January 1, 2025 on.
